context: All three are built by one function, f_7100523f10 (call it BuildLineChain), on the collision-manager singleton M = [0x71052B9298] (the same singleton whose +0x218/+0x220 hold the 350 x 0x6E0 ground-collision record pool). BuildLineChain(M, group index, point array (16-byte vec4 per point), point count, per-segment normal array (16-byte stride), per-segment u32 flags array, per-segment u32 material array, flag) builds one polyline: one C (chain), one B per point, one A per segment between consecutive points, plus one 0x140-byte owner/transform object D. It is called from f_7102628310 (stage-model collision loader, two call sites inside its per-group loop): 0x7102629cb0 when bit 16 of the group's flag word is set (that path then fills D's initial transform: D+0x10 position, D+0x30 angle, D+0x50 scale, D+0x129 dirty, from the group's model entry), 0x7102629c50 otherwise (no transform set up there). Both paths then call f_71031653d0(stage model part, D) and set C+0xEC = NOT(group flag bit 1). The group's points/count/normals come from the model entry +0x110/+0x108/+0x120; per-segment flag words get |0x2000 (bit 13 = passable) when an entry's bit is set.

A.allocated_by: f_7100523f10 (BuildLineChain): allocation call at return address 0x7100524308 (f_710392e290, align 0x10, size 0x120) inside its per-segment loop; called by f_7102628310 at 0x7102629cb0 (bit-16 groups) or 0x7102629c50 (other groups). Constructor f_7100532e60, then segment setup f_71005334a0.
A.built: f_7100532e60(A, M+8, C, id): +0x10 = parent chain C; +0xF0 = M+8 (a slot table of 24-byte entries); +0xF8 = id (M's u32 counter at M+0, post-incremented); +0xFC = index of a free slot claimed in that table (slot: used byte, owner = A at +8, +0x14 = C+0x10 group kind), registered by a virtual call on the table's +0x18 object; +0x100 = 1 (valid); +0x110/+0x118 = a 0x20-byte helper object (vptr 0x7104F763E8); +0x40..+0x98 zeroed. Pushed onto M's vector +0x158..+0x168 and appended to C's segment list C+0x80 (node at A+0/A+8, count C+0x78). f_71005334a0(A, ..., B_prev, B_next, flags, material, flag): +0x88/+0x90 = the two end vertices (B) ordered by x; +0x20/+0x30 = bounding box of the endpoints; +0xA0 = normalized normal/direction; +0xB0 = the source normal kept as rest value; +0xC0 = a float from the endpoints; +0xC4 = line flags (input | 0x20000; type bits 0xF00 = 0x100/0x200/0x400/0x800, 0x1000 added by a length/x test, bit 13 0x2000 = passable); +0xC8 = flags copy, +0xCC = flags & 0xF00 (type); +0xD0 = material (u32, compared with 0x16); bytes +0xE8/+0xE9. With no type bit given, f_71005332b0 classifies the line from its normal angle (atan2) against the chain's thresholds C+0xC4 (0.698 rad = 40 deg) and C+0xC8 (1.2217 rad = 70 deg), setting 0x400/0x800 (walls) or 0x100/0x200 (floor/ceiling).
A.per_frame: f_7100533020(A, flag), reached from the manager's per-frame update f_7100522f30 (through f_71005324f0 and related): reloads the endpoints from its two vertices (B+0x10), swaps +0x88/+0x90 if their x order flipped, rewrites the bounding box +0x20/+0x30 and +0xC0, rotates the rest normal +0xB0 by the chain angle C+0xC0 (sin/cos via f_71039c07d0/f_71039c07e0) into +0xA0, re-runs the floor/wall/ceiling classification f_71005332b0 (updates +0xC4/+0xCC), clears per-frame fields +0x60..+0x80, and re-registers the segment in the broadphase (virtual slot +0x28 on [A+0xF0]+0x18 with slot +0xFC, both endpoints, the normal and the passable bit 13). f_710260e040 (the '1,024-entry presentation table' tick) walks each chain's segment list C+0x80 and bins each A into cell entries (ceil/divide of coordinates, at most 0x7FF entries), comparing A+0xF8 (id), A+0x100 and A+0xD4 and reading A+0x88/+0x90 and A+0xC4: it looks like a spatial grid of collision lines rather than a presentation table.
A.link_to_ground_collision: Yes, by layout match. The existing GroundModule reading (research/map/code_reading/GroundModule_CameraModule.json) found that the touched-line object L(k) = [R+0x10+0x30k] is read at +0xC4 (u32 flags; bit 13 = is_passable_ground, bit 7 = ignore-other-fighter wall), +0xC6 bit 4 (flag bit 20), +0xD0 (u32 material), +0x100 (u8 valid), +0xF8 (u32 id). A has exactly these fields: flags at +0xC4 with bit 13 = passable (also passed to the broadphase as the passable flag), material at +0xD0, valid byte +0x100 set to 1 by the constructor, id at +0xF8. Also, the record pool (M+0x220) and the A/B/C/D vectors (M+0x140/+0x158/+0x188/+0x1A0) belong to the same singleton M, and the manager reset f_7100521220 clears both the records and the chains. I did not find the exact instruction that stores an A into R+0x10+0x30k (queries go through the broadphase slot table, whose entry +8 holds the A).
A.what: One stage collision line segment: an edge between two consecutive points of a collision polyline, with its type (floor / ceiling / left wall / right wall), material, passable flag, normal and bounding box. It is the object GroundModule calls the touched line L(k).
A.evidence: One A per segment in the BuildLineChain loop; end-vertex pointers +0x88/+0x90; floor/wall/ceiling classification by normal angle against 40/70 degree thresholds; field-for-field match with the touched-line object GroundModule reads (+0xC4 flags incl. passable bit 13, +0xD0 material, +0xF8 id, +0x100 valid); the per-frame endpoint/normal recompute in f_7100533020 explains why changing them changes fighter movement.

B.allocated_by: f_710052fde0 (vertex allocator; allocation call at return address 0x710052fe0c, size 0x60), called by f_7100523f10 at 0x71005244dc for every point after the first. The first point of each chain comes from the call at 0x71005241a4, whose second return address differs, so it is not in the measured B counts.
B.built: f_710052fde0(M): zeroes +0x10..+0x4F, +0x50 = u16 1, +0x52 = 0, pushes it onto M's vertex vector +0x140..+0x150. f_7100523f10 then sets +0x10/+0x18 (current position) and +0x30/+0x38 (rest/local position) from the point array, +0x20 = copy of +0x10 (previous position), +0x40 = a normalized 2-D vector from the normal array with tiny components snapped to zero (threshold at 0x7104472970), and appends it to C's vertex list C+0x68 (node at B+0/B+8, count C+0x60). Each point also widens C's bounding box C+0x20/+0x30.
B.per_frame: In f_7100522f30, for each owner D: if D+0x129 (transform dirty), f_7100532810(C, D+0x10 position, D+0x40 pivot, angle/scale from D+0x30/D+0x50) recomputes every vertex: previous (+0x20) = current (+0x10), current = position + rotation(angle) * scale * (rest +0x30 - pivot); sets B+0x51 = moved and C+0xE5/+0xE6 changed flags, stores the angle in C+0xC0, then recomputes each segment's direction from its vertices. If only D+0x12A is set, it copies current to previous for each vertex (+0x51 = 1) and shifts C's bounding box (+0x20/+0x30 into +0x40/+0x50). Segments (A) read B+0x10 every frame in f_7100533020.
B.link_to_ground_collision: Indirect: B are the endpoints referenced by A+0x88/+0x90, so GroundModule reaches them through the touched line L(k). I did not find a record field pointing straight at a B.
B.what: One vertex (point) of a stage collision polyline: current, previous and rest positions plus a per-point normal, shared by the segments that meet there.
B.evidence: One B per point, linked in C+0x68 with a count; positions copied from the point array; per-frame current/previous/rest position update under the owner's transform; segments take their endpoints from B+0x10. Caveat: the code allocates one B through 0x71005244dc per A, yet the measured counts differ slightly (FD 9 B vs 10 A, Castle 64 21-26 vs 36); I cannot explain that from the code alone (different counting window, or the allocator call at 0x710052fe50 retry path).

C.allocated_by: f_7100523f10, allocation call at return address 0x7100523f88 (size 0x100) at the start of the function; caller f_7102628310 at 0x7102629cb0 (measured) or 0x7102629c50.
C.built: +0x10 = u32 group kind (read from the group header [M+0x30+8*index]+0x30), +0x14 = flag argument; +0x18 = its owner D (set at the end); empty intrusive lists: +0x68 vertices (count +0x60), +0x80 segments (count +0x78), +0x98 a third list; +0x20/+0x30 bounding box (+0x40/+0x50 previous box, copied from the final box); +0xB0 = a 16-byte constant vector; +0xC4 = 0.698 (40 deg) and +0xC8 = 1.2217 (70 deg) floor/wall angle thresholds; +0xC0 = current angle; +0xD8 = -1; bytes +0xE0 = 0x0101, +0xE2 = 1, +0xE8 = 1, +0xEC = 1 (later NOT(group flag bit 1)). Pushed onto M's chain vector +0x188..+0x198 and onto the per-group list at [M+0x30+8*index] (count at its +0). f_7100531a00(C) finishes setup. Then the 0x140-byte owner D is allocated (at 0x71005246bc; id from M+4), pushed onto M+0x1A0..+0x1B0, D+8 = C, D+0x128 = 1 (active), then f_7100532bc0(C, 1).
C.per_frame: Reached through its owner D in f_7100522f30: the transform is applied to all its vertices (f_7100532810), angle stored at +0xC0, change flags +0xE5/+0xE6/+0xEB, bounding box saved and recomputed; its segment list +0x80 is walked by f_710260e040 and by the segment update (f_7100533020 reads C+0xE7 and C+0xC0).
C.link_to_ground_collision: Indirect: each touched line A points back to its C at A+0x10 (and the broadphase slot stores C+0x10 as the group kind). Same singleton as the ground records.
C.what: One stage collision line group: a connected polyline (chain of vertices and segments) belonging to one part of the stage model, with its bounding box, angle and floor/wall angle thresholds. Its 0x140-byte owner D carries the transform (position, angle, pivot, scale) that moves it with the stage part.
C.evidence: Created once per BuildLineChain call; owns the vertex list and segment list; holds the 40/70 degree classification thresholds read by f_71005332b0; moved as a whole by the transform in f_7100532810. Counts fit: FD 8 chains / 10 segments, Battlefield 8 / 13 (main stage plus platforms, each a separate chain).

notes: Hypothesis confirmed: A = collision line segments, B = their vertices, C = line groups (polylines), all owned by the collision-manager singleton [0x71052B9298], which also owns the 350-entry ground-collision record pool. A fourth object, D (0x140 bytes, one per C, vector M+0x1A0), is the group's transform/owner: f_7100522f30 iterates M+0x1A0 and, when D+0x129 is set, moves the group from D+0x10 (position), D+0x30 (angle), D+0x40 (pivot), D+0x50 (scale). The nine times larger per-frame state with hazards on fits moving collision (platforms and hazards animating). Not settled: which of 0x100/0x200 is floor vs ceiling and which of 0x400/0x800 is left vs right wall; the meaning of group flag bit 16 (only the 0x7102629cb0 path sets D's initial transform, so probably groups attached to an animated model part, unverified). f_710260e040 looks like a spatial grid of the lines (cell indices from coordinates, at most 0x7FF entries), not a presentation table. rtti.py gave no names for any of these functions; all names here come from reading the code.
